name: Al-Khidr
description: Al-Khidr ('the Green One') is a Quranic figure of Islamic tradition described in Surah al-Kahf 18:65–82 as a righteous servant of God endowed with hidden knowledge. He is variously identified as an angel, prophet, or saint (wali), and is held by many traditions to be still alive, guiding seekers and aiding those in distress.

aliases.name: Khiḍr Elias
aliases.meaning: Khidr-Elijah, paired with the prophet Elijah

origin: A pan-Islamic figure with regional inflections across the Arab world, Iran, Turkey, the Balkans, the Caucasus, the Indian subcontinent, and the Malay archipelago; also venerated by Druze and (under different names) by Christian and Yazidi communities.
